# Studiely

> Studiely is an AI-powered study platform for school students. It helps students create curriculum-aligned notes, flashcards, quizzes, exam practice and revision priorities, with Nyla as an AI study tutor. Free to start on web, iOS and Android.

Studiely supports major school pathways including IGCSE, GCSE, IB, A-Level, AP, HSC and other regional curricula. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official product of Cambridge Assessment International Education, Pearson Edexcel, AQA, OCR, the IB Organisation, or any other examination board.

- [Home](https://studiely.com/): Overview of Studiely study tools and how the platform works

- [Nyla AI Tutor](https://studiely.com/nyla): Product page for Studiely’s AI study tutor
- [FAQs](https://studiely.com/faqs): Common questions about Studiely, plans and study tools
- [Blog](https://studiely.com/blogs): Study tips, product updates and education articles
- [Contact](https://studiely.com/contact): Support and contact options for Studiely
